responsibility: This definition module declares the minimal foreign-function interface from GNU Modula-2 to the tiny C support layer used by gm2-libs-min. It exposes C-linked abort, exit, and printf through a FOR "C" module so Modula-2 runtime stubs such as M2RTS can name the expected libc entry points while keeping the actual linked C dependency set as small as possible.
same_name_distinction: Unlike libc.c, which provides the actual C object code, this same-stem file is the Modula-2 FOR "C" definition module that declares the foreign libc entry points abort, exit, and printf for use from Modula-2 code.
